meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

copy.tagline: 处理化学分子数据，计算描述符和指纹。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在药物发现中处理分子结构并计算属性。
copy.tagline_en: Process chemical molecular data, compute descriptors and fingerprints.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle molecular structures and compute properties in drug discovery.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 能直接调用 datamol 库处理化学分子：解析 SMILES、标准化结构、计算描述符和指纹、做聚类与 3D 构象生成等，返回 RDKit 分子对象，适合药物发现相关任务。
howto.when: 当用户需要处理化学分子，如解析 SMILES、计算描述符、做聚类等药物发现相关分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我从这些 SMILES 计算分子量和 LogP
用 datamol 对这批分子做 Butina 聚类
say.note: Claude 会按结构相似度分组并输出簇。

say.text: 生成这组分子的 ECFP4 指纹并算相似度
say.note: Claude 会计算指纹矩阵并给出距离结果。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use the datamol library to handle chemical molecules: parse SMILES, standardize structures, compute descriptors and fingerprints, cluster, and generate 3D conformers, returning native RDKit Mol objects for drug discovery tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to process chemical molecules, such as parsing SMILES, computing descriptors, clustering, or other drug-discovery analyses.

say_en.text: Calculate molecular weight and LogP from these SMILES.
say_en.note: Claude will use datamol to compute descriptors and return a table.

say_en.text: Use datamol to do Butina clustering on this molecule set.
say_en.note: Claude will group molecules by structural similarity.

say_en.text: Generate ECFP4 fingerprints for these molecules and compute similarities.
say_en.note: Claude will compute the fingerprint matrix and distance results.
